topic: Tutorial: get ChatGPT's new Intelligent UI to build you a live calculator
post:
ChatGPT can now build you a working calculator inside the chat. No code. 🧮
Here's how to try it in 2 minutes.

With GPT-6, OpenAI added "Intelligent UI": answers can include charts, forms and small interactive tools, not just text. It's in the regular Chat tab on every plan, including Free.

The trick: you don't ask for an "app." You describe the tool and the numbers. 👇

1️⃣ Open a new chat in the Chat tab
2️⃣ Describe the inputs, the math and the result you want
3️⃣ Change the numbers right inside the answer

Try this one:
"Make me an event budget calculator. Inputs: number of guests, food cost per person, venue fee, and total budget. Show the total cost and how much budget is left, update as I change inputs, and show the formulas."

That last part matters ✅
Asking it to show the formulas lets you check the math. Reviewers have flagged that interactive answers can still get things wrong, so verify any number you'll act on.

Why it matters:
AI answers are turning into mini tools. The skill isn't coding. It's describing exactly what you need.

Practical takeaway:
Pick one spreadsheet you rebuild every month and try it as a ChatGPT calculator this week.

What calculator would save you the most time? 👇
